sections.description:
A new patch is now live on Windows PC. Read below to learn more about the latest changes.

To share your feedback, please post in the General Discussion forum For a list of known issues, visit our Bug Report forum. For troubleshooting assistance, visit our Technical Support forum.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Fixed a bug that made it possible in rare circumstances to lose ultimate charge.
- Fixed a bug that prevented Competitive Play groups being found in LFG.
- Fixed rare instances of "avoid as teammate" not working.

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that caused Kendoka Genji to briefly t-pose during the outro for his Meditate emote.
